description: Default capabilities for the NexusCore desktop window. NOTE: sql:allow-execute is deliberately absent and must stay absent — it is blanket permission to run any statement, which would let frontend code INSERT a ledger event header and its lines in two separate non-atomic calls, the exact corruption ledger_append exists to prevent. tauri-plugin-sql is the read path only; all writes go through the ledger_append and reference_write commands. See docs/LEDGER_SCHEMA.md section 7.
